evidence.title: Our decision on Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX

summary: SpaceX has completed its acquisition of the AI-powered coding tool Cursor, aiming to incorporate its technology into the company’s software development ecosystem. In a statement, SpaceX outlined its decision to evaluate and integrate Cursor’s capabilities to enhance internal tooling and future product offerings.
title: SpaceX Acquires AI Coding Assistant Cursor, Announces Integration Plans
